# Trelto

> Trelto provides search engine optimization (SEO) and AI search optimization (also called answer engine optimization, AEO) for local service companies such as HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, home services, med spas, clinics, and gyms. The goal is more calls, form leads, and booked jobs from Google Search, Google Maps, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, Gemini, ChatGPT, and Perplexity.

Trelto is a service of Geyer Digital Support LLC. Contact: hello@trelto.com. Work is done by email; no sales call is required.

## Services
- Google Business Profile and Google Maps optimization
- Local SEO for existing websites: service and city pages, titles, on-page fixes
- AI search optimization for Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, Gemini, ChatGPT, and Perplexity
- Schema markup (LocalBusiness, FAQ) and crawler-access checks
- Review-request system using real customers only (Trelto never buys, writes, or filters reviews)
- Directory and listings cleanup

## How results are measured
Before work starts, the client and Trelto agree on 6 Google and Google Maps searches and 10 buyer questions. Each AI question is run 3 times on the same tools on day 0, day 30, and day 60, and the client receives the dated raw results. Trelto does not promise a #1 ranking or a number of leads.

## Pricing
- Free visibility check: emailed within 48 hours of a complete request.
- Founding Sprint: 60-day local SEO and AI visibility sprint for up to three founding clients, $297 paid at signup, refunded in full if the day-60 result is not a PASS as defined in the terms.
- Care plan: $397 per month, starting after the 60-day sprint (day 61), month-to-month, cancel anytime by email before the next renewal. Includes a monthly re-measure of the same Maps keywords and AI prompts with a 1-page scorecard, Google Business Profile upkeep, review monitoring and owner nudges, one new or refreshed town or service page a month, and fixes when something breaks. The founding $297 covers the full 60-day sprint with no second bill.
